profile.headline: Software Systems Engineer at Sandia National Laboratories

positions.title: Risk Assurance Senior Associate
positions.description:
- Coach and lead staff throughout internal / external audits.
- Plan and manage projects through regular report of budget/schedule status and forecasts to stakeholders. 
- Coordinate and lead meeting for internal/external executive management.
- Consult PwC US teams as a subject matter specialist in the Risk Assurance Technology Enablement Center (RATEC) over SAP IT general controls and application controls. 
- Conduct research over multiple SAP solutions to support internal/external engagement risk assessments 
- Collaborate with clients to develop understanding of the client's business and IT environments. 
- Evaluate internal controls design, identify risks and controls, develop/ review audit programs, and perform controls optimization.

positions.title: Risk Assurance Associate
positions.description:
- Assist management in the assessment of risks and controls within the IT environment. 
- Apply the concepts of Enterprise Risk Management to help companies identify, assess, mitigate and proactively consider emerging risks.
- Develop and execute project plans, budgets, and schedule of deliverables for internal and external audits. 
- Provide engagement teams across the nation with assistance in technical risk and control recommendations within SAP environments.

positions.title: Project Controls Intern
positions.description:
•	Created, validated, and maintained project schedule and reported on monthly and weekly financial/schedule status using dashboards to send to upper management and customers to maintain a proactive strategy and mitigate risk.
•	Conducted researched, assembled, and evaluated project data corporate reporting tools to resolve financial and schedule related issues in an earned value environment.
•	Analyzed and monitored project schedule and financial data and progress and forecasted new timelines to maintain a realistic scope of work.
•	Monitored team member progress to ensure timely completion of project tasks and in turn, lowered schedule and cost variance throughout project duration.
•	Availed leadership as head scheduler for technical team and facilitated on-time completion and scheduling of major milestones within an integrated schedule.
•	Assisted organization in designing and creating SharePoint website for the program that facilitates user efficiency among the Project Controls team.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
•	Tutored individual or small groups of 1-5 students throughout the semester
•	Assisted in academic research on corporate transparency, opacity, analyst herding, venture capital, & private equity.
•	Performed literature searches and reviews in subject areas such as accounting, finance, public policy, econometrics and economics.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
•	Transcribed depositions 
•	Assisted with bilingual clients involved in Social Security cases
•	Assisted in organizing my employers schedule through effectively and efficiently scheduling appointments.
•	Provided training for incoming personnel through the use of effective coaching.
